RRS 110 Critical Thinking and the Ethnic Studies Experience (Units: 3) Basic skills involved in understanding, criticizing, and constructing arguments by using materials reflective of experiences of Indigenous and racialized groups in the U.S. (This course is offered as ETHS 110 and RRS 110.
